verdict.rationale: An official CLI is a reasonable thing to ask of an inference API platform, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only official Python and Node SDKs, a browser console and playground, and curl or bash examples. The llm-cerebras plugin is a community add-on to a third-party tool, which counts as a user-side workaround, so nothing here shows a first-party Cerebras CLI.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
